evidence: Between validation runs the live runner reset the settings alone (web/src/llm/evals/validation.live.test.ts:148), while a run reads more of the app than its messages and its dataset. run_log reads the pipeline store's log of the last run (web/src/llm/tools/defs/run_log.ts:20), so a run read the run before's. current_view reads the page and both viewers' cuts (web/src/llm/tools/defs/current_view.ts:19-21), which show_in_viewer (web/src/llm/tools/openView.ts:22-53), dpdf_contrast (dpdf_contrast.ts:81), run_pipeline (run_pipeline.ts:64) and tune_pipeline (tune_pipeline.ts:83) set. The tuning store kept its trials, and a tuning run cut short by the run's time limit kept it active (web/src/llm/tune/tuner.ts:76-83), which refuses every change (web/src/llm/tools/shared/pipeline.ts:11). A server found refusing tools was kept at module scope by base URL and model (web/src/llm/agent.ts:93, :321), so every later run of the plan went without tools (agent.ts:203). The token calibration (web/src/llm/provider/tokens.ts:67, :86), which decides when a local model's older results are shortened (agent.ts:259), carried over unrecorded. In the app, every earlier turn's tool result was a number source for the next reply (toolResultsIn, agent.ts:158-159, read at :368), whatever ran since, while a verdict's evidence counts only after the last run that recomputed its stage (web/src/llm/evidence.ts:18-34; web/src/llm/answerChecks.ts:203-215).
proposed_fix: Each run is one function's, which the live runner calls and a replay test drives (runCase, web/src/llm/evals/validationRun.ts). Before each run, startFresh puts the pipeline store (the settings and the job: its log, its end, its id), the tuning store and the console's view stores (the page, both viewers' cuts and focus, the ΔPDF's contrast) back to a fresh page's, selects the run's dataset and forgets the servers found refusing tools; a pipeline run or tuning run a run cut short left going is stopped and waited for first, and one that does not end stops the plan. The token calibration is the model's and its server's, so it is kept, and each run's record keeps the one it started from (tokens_at_start, optional). In the app, the chat hands the next reply its earlier turns' tool calls (toolStepsIn, ToolContext.earlierSteps), and earlierSources (answerChecks.ts) counts each result while no run since, between the turns or in the reply, has recomputed the stage of a topic it settles (recomputedAt, as for a verdict's evidence), an assessment of several stages keeping the stages still standing; a number only such a result holds goes back as measured before that run, in words that name no tool, stage or skill.
tests: web/src/llm/evals/validationRun.replay.test.ts (two scripted runs back to back through runCase on a dev case: the second reads none of the first's log, views, tuning run or settings, and is offered the tools its server refused in the first; each record keeps the token calibration its run started from)

web/src/llm/evals/validationRun.test.ts (startFresh clears the pipeline, tuning and view stores and the servers found refusing tools, keeps the token calibration, and stops and waits for a pipeline or tuning run a run cut short left going, or refuses to start the next run)
web/src/llm/evals/validation.test.ts (the record keeps tokens_at_start; the field is optional, the schema unchanged)
web/src/llm/__tests__/agent.test.ts (turn 1 reads the flatten; the flatten is run again between the turns, or in turn 2; turn 2's number from turn 1's result is sent back as measured before that run)

web/src/llm/__tests__/answerChecks.test.ts (earlierSources: a run before the result, or one that reused its stage, leaves it standing; a later run that recomputed the stage takes it out, an assessment of several stages keeping the stages still standing; the raw volume's results stand)
web/src/llm/__tests__/modelVisible.test.ts (5-answer-checks.md, 5-answer-checks-arm-c.md: the send-back on numbers measured before a later run, the same in both arms)
web/src/llm/__tests__/armC.test.ts (arm C's second turn quotes a number from before the first turn's rerun: its send-back names no tool, stage or skill)
note: Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19 (plan 1.2). Implemented in a4b16d7 (each validation run starts fresh, and its record keeps the token calibration it started from) and 2c14ff9 (an earlier turn's result as a number source). The verdicts and their goldens are unchanged, and arm A is unaffected (TypeScript only). The model reads one new send-back line, the same in both arms, about 39 estimated tokens plus the numbers it lists, sent only when a number comes from a result a later run made stale; every token-budget pin is unchanged. Left: a run started from the console between turns is in no turn's steps, so it makes no earlier result stale; and, found while listing what a run reads, a tuning run's proposals ask the console's LLM settings (settings.ts), which in the live runner are the defaults, not the run's model (read in the code, not run). Decided for that last one by the manager, on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19: tune_pipeline in a validation run uses the run's own model, and its tokens count in the run's usage (kept apart in usage.tuning), its cost and the paid model's spend cap, with a test. Implemented in 741fd4c; in the app the tuning still asks the console's settings. Then, decided by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-24: the cap stays $12, NEBULA's share of the user's $40 across three apps' runs, and the gate says so; the first run's reserve rises from $1.20 to $5 to cover a run that tunes (FIRST_RUN_WORST in validationModels.ts states the arithmetic). Implemented in c1d0b9e.
